국.x: I eat rice and soup together.
국.e: Not the 국 'country' in 한국 — a different word. 국물 = broth.
국.t: 국 is thin and brothy; 찌개 is thicker and saltier. Both are eaten with rice.

축하.ex: 졸업식 날 많은 사람들에게 축하를 받았어요.
축하.x: On graduation day, lots of people congratulated me.
축하.t: Pronounced [추카]; say 축하해요, or more politely 축하드려요, for 'congratulations'.

명함.x: I exchanged business cards with someone I met for the first time.
명함.t: Give and receive business cards with both hands as a sign of respect.

육아.x: These days dads are also very involved in childcare.

당시.m: at that time, back then, those days
당시.x: Back then, we didn't have a cell phone at home.

삭감.x: The company was struggling, so employees' pay was cut.
삭감.t: Common phrases: 예산 삭감 (budget cut) and 임금 삭감 (pay cut).

격리.ex: 확진자는 일주일 동안 집에서 격리를 해야 했어요.
격리.x: Confirmed cases had to isolate at home for a week.

프로그래밍.x: These days even elementary school kids learn programming at school.

저기압.ex: 저기압이 다가오면서 오늘 밤부터 비가 내리겠습니다.
저기압.x: Rain is expected from tonight as a low-pressure system approaches.
저기압.t: Casual slang: 저기압이다 means someone is in a gloomy or bad mood.

공문.x: The school sent an official letter to the parents.

경계심.x: The cat was wary of the stranger.

각오.ex: 이번 시험에 꼭 합격하겠다는 각오로 공부하고 있어요.
각오.x: I'm studying with the resolve to pass this exam no matter what.
각오.e: Literally 'awaken and realize' — facing clearly what is coming.
각오.t: 각오하다 also means bracing for something bad: 각오해! 'You'd better be ready!'

의존적.x: He's still too dependent on his parents.

공연히.forms: 공연히 + verb (공연히 걱정하다); spoken form 괜히
공연히.m: for no reason, needlessly, in vain
공연히.ex: 공연히 걱정만 하지 말고 직접 물어보세요.
공연히.x: Don't just worry for nothing; ask directly.
공연히.e: Literally 'emptily so': doing something with no real purpose.

취준생.ex: 저는 요즘 취준생이라서 매일 도서관에 가요.
취준생.x: I'm job hunting these days, so I go to the library every day.
취준생.e: Short for 취(업) 준(비)생 'person preparing for employment'.
취준생.t: Informal but widely used, even in news; many build up 스펙 'qualifications' like test scores and certificates.

족보.ex: 우리 집안 족보에는 조상들의 이름이 적혀 있어요.
족보.x: Our family genealogy lists the names of our ancestors.
족보.t: Student slang: 족보 also means a collection of past exam questions passed down by seniors.

평가절하하다.m: to undervalue, to downplay; to devalue (a currency)
평가절하하다.x: Don't downplay his hard work as mere luck.
평가절하하다.e: Literally 'cut the assessed value down'; originally a currency term.

망라하다.m: to cover comprehensively, to include all
망라하다.ex: 이 책은 한국 음식의 역사를 총망라하고 있어요.
망라하다.x: This book comprehensively covers the history of Korean food.
망라하다.e: Literally 'fishing net and bird net' — catching everything.
망라하다.t: Pronounced [망나하다] — ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

얕보다.m: to look down on, to underestimate, to make light of
얕보다.x: Don't underestimate someone just because they're young.
얕보다.e: 얕다 'shallow' + 보다 'to see': seeing someone as shallow.

눈엣가시.m: a thorn in one's side; a person one can't stand
눈엣가시.ex: 새로 온 직원은 부장님에게 눈엣가시 같은 존재예요.
눈엣가시.x: The new employee is like a thorn in the manager's side.
눈엣가시.e: 눈 'eye' + 에 + 가시 'thorn': literally 'a thorn in the eye.'
눈엣가시.t: Pronounced [누네까시]; common as 눈엣가시로 여기다 'to see someone as a thorn in one's side.'

압수.ex: 경찰은 그의 집에서 컴퓨터와 서류를 압수했습니다.
압수.x: Police seized a computer and documents from his house.
압수.e: Literally 'pressing and taking in' — officially taking someone's property.
압수.t: Often paired as 압수 수색 'search and seizure', which is said as one phrase.

목사.x: Listening to the pastor's words, I felt at peace.
목사.e: Literally 'shepherd teacher', a pastor tending his flock.
목사.t: Usually addressed with the honorific 목사님; a Catholic priest is 신부님, not 목사님.

혹서.ex: 올여름 혹서 때문에 전기 사용량이 크게 늘었습니다.
혹서.x: Electricity use rose sharply because of this summer's intense heat.
혹서.t: 혹서 is a written, formal word; in daily speech 폭염 or 무더위 is far more common.

연기력.ex: 그 배우는 연기력을 인정받아 상을 받았어요.
연기력.x: That actor won an award in recognition of his acting skills.

공소 시효.ex: 그 사건은 공소 시효가 지나서 처벌할 수 없습니다.
공소 시효.x: No one can be punished for that case because the statute of limitations has expired.
공소 시효.e: 공소 = public prosecution; 시효 = time limit on its effect.
공소 시효.t: Common phrases: 공소 시효가 지나다 or 끝나다 (expire) and 공소 시효를 폐지하다 (abolish).

각인되다.m: to be imprinted, to be engraved (in one's mind)
각인되다.x: The memory of that day was deeply imprinted in my mind.
각인되다.t: Very common with images: 이미지가 각인되다, 'an image gets fixed in people's minds.'

약관.m: terms and conditions, terms of service
약관.ex: 가입하기 전에 이용 약관을 꼼꼼히 읽어 보세요.
약관.x: Read the terms of service carefully before signing up.
약관.e: Literally 'agreement clauses'; a literary homonym 약관 means 'age twenty'.
약관.t: On websites you'll often see a checkbox saying 약관에 동의합니다 'I agree to the terms'.

법치.x: When the rule of law collapses, social order is shaken too.
rel: principle of the rule of law

항원.ex: 신속 항원 검사는 결과가 빨리 나와요.
항원.x: Rapid antigen tests give results quickly.
항원.e: Literally 'what the resistance originates from' — it triggers antibodies.
항원.t: Easy to mix up: 항원 is the invader (antigen), 항체 is your defense (antibody).

숙주.m: host (organism a parasite or virus lives on)
숙주.ex: 이 바이러스는 박쥐를 숙주로 삼는 것으로 알려져 있습니다.
숙주.x: This virus is known to use bats as its host.
숙주.e: Literally 'the master of the lodging' — the one who houses the guest.
숙주.t: Don't confuse it with 숙주나물 (mung bean sprouts) — same sound, unrelated food word.

성운.ex: 망원경으로 보면 성운은 희미한 구름처럼 보여요.
성운.x: Through a telescope, a nebula looks like a faint cloud.

작품세계.m: an artist's body of work, artistic world
작품세계.ex: 이 전시회에서 작가의 작품세계를 한눈에 볼 수 있어요.
작품세계.x: At this exhibition, you can see the artist's whole body of work at a glance.
작품세계.e: Literally 'works world' — the themes and style running through all of an artist's works.

르네상스.ex: 르네상스 시대에는 미술과 과학이 함께 발전했어요.
르네상스.x: During the Renaissance, art and science developed together.
르네상스.e: From French 'Renaissance' (rebirth); also used for any revival or golden age.
르네상스.t: Used figuratively too: 한국 영화의 르네상스 means a golden age of Korean film.

국권피탈.m: loss of national sovereignty; Japan's annexation of Korea (1910)
국권피탈.x: With the loss of sovereignty in 1910, the Korean Empire became a Japanese colony.
국권피탈.t: Textbooks now prefer 국권피탈 over 한일합병, which sounds like a voluntary merger.

숙고하다.x: I'll decide after giving it careful thought.
숙고하다.e: Literally 'ripe thinking' — thoughts left to mature.
숙고하다.t: Often appears as the idiom 심사숙고하다 = to think long and hard.

문화접변.ex: 이민자들은 새로운 사회에서 문화접변을 겪게 됩니다.
문화접변.x: Immigrants go through acculturation in a new society.
문화접변.e: Literally 'culture touches and changes': two cultures meet and both shift.
문화접변.t: Pronounced [문화접뼌]: the ㅂ becomes tense (the ㅎ is kept in standard pronunciation).

정진하다.m: to devote oneself to, to strive diligently
정진하다.ex: 그는 은퇴 후에도 연구에 정진하고 있어요.
정진하다.x: Even after retiring, he is devoting himself to his research.
정진하다.e: Literally 'advance with purity' — originally Buddhist striving toward enlightenment.

등고자비.m: every great journey starts with small steps
등고자비.x: As the saying goes, climb from the bottom: study the basics step by step.
등고자비.e: Literally 'to climb high, start from low ground'.
등고자비.t: Also used to mean the higher your position, the humbler you should be.
